title: The Subtle Art of Not Giving a F*ck
author: Mark Manson
summary: Mark Manson argues that a good life comes from choosing what is worth caring about, accepting limits and taking responsibility, rather than chasing constant positivity.
readIf: you want blunt, sweary, humorous self-help that rejects relentless optimism.
skipIf: you dislike profanity or want research-heavy advice.
